nom: Dr. Althea Vitamin C Boosting Serum

segments.oily: One oily-skin reviewer found the serum pills during the day and interferes with makeup application, while another warns that combining it with a rich moisturizer can leave skin oily and irritated.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing their skin as sensitive report it does not burn on open sores, does not cause redness, and feels gentle and refreshing; one long-term user also calls it gentle for sensitive skin.

concerns.dehydration: One reviewer describes the serum as deeply moisturizing, with skin feeling soaked on application and plump once dry; another cautions that layering it with a rich moisturizer can tip oily skin into feeling over-hydrated and irritated.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with blemishes and breakouts says the serum calms redness; another with sensitive skin states it does not make the face red or burn.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report the serum helped fade post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, dark spots, and pigmentation, with one describing it as the best product she's tried for scars and dullness after finishing a full bottle.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with acne and scars reports clearer skin after use; another says it calms redness from blemishes and breakouts; a third reports zero irritation or breakouts over several weeks of use.
concerns.oiliness: An oily-skin reviewer reports pilling and difficulty applying makeup over it; another notes that using it together with a rich moisturizer can leave oily skin feeling oily and irritated.

aspects.libelle: Overuse with rich moisturizer causes oiliness

extraits.texte: this serum is great: it sits beautifully on the skin and it brightens it! as an oily skin girl, i thought at first that this serum would be the one, but i noticed that it pills throughout the day and i can't even do my makeup whenever i use this product.

This product helped calm down the post inflamitory hyperpigmentation on my chin and has lightened some dark spots throughout my face. I have been using this product for several weeks now both in the moring and night. I experienced zero irritation or breakouts with this product. I highly recommend this product for anyone who is interesred!

Ive been using it for 2 weeks now & i can say it works! Anytime ive had blemishes or breakouts, using this helps calm down the redness. It really does even out irregular skin tone. I use this with the Dr. Althea deep moisturizer & it works good together! If you use both together, i highly suggest finding out if using both everyday works for you, or not. As they are both deeply moisturizerizing, using too much of both can leave your skin oily & irritated.

extraits.titre: If I had to have one product for the rest of my life
extraits.texte: Now that I have finished a full bottle I can give you a honest review. I am a (25year F) I have struggled with acne, scars, dullness, pigmentation I have had it all. This product is the best on the market. I have noticed my skin is plump, it glows, my face is clear yall. I use a whole syringe if not a whole and a half each night and morning, your face will feel like it is soaked but, by the time it drys, You look like a glowing supermodel. The review about wearing makeup after this product is tru. It will pill. This is a product you wear when you are going for a clean makeup look, like concealer under eyes and spot coverage/blush. But no foundation. Honestly after a couple of week of using this. You won't need foundation. I have constantly wore all the heavy products all my life. Now I find myself never reaching for foundation anymore because this stuff has boosted my confidence so much and made such a difference in my face. I can not express more how good this stuff is. It does not burn on open sores and is very refreshing. It does not make your face red and burn, it's very sensitive. Buying this for the rest of my life!!!!!!

Im half way done with my third bottle of this serum and its gentle for sensitive skin. My hysband even said my skin has brightened in the past year or so thanks to the vitamin c serum 😂 i used to use dermalogica for years, but switch to this last year to save money and its been doing wonders. But, DONT SLEEP ON YOUR SKIN ROUTINE! It's very important to get that healthy skin.

reserve: Only 8 reviews are available and one lacks any concrete detail, so conclusions for skin types other than oily and sensitive, and for concerns like aging and barrier, rest on very thin evidence.
